bear_case: The VIX at 18.06 is at but not clearly above the bearish trigger threshold, and high-yield credit spreads remain tight at 2.79% — neither reading is consistent with systemic risk. A market down only -0.67% despite a 30Y surge to an 18-year high and a failed Trump-Xi summit may be exhibiting relative resilience rather than incipient breakdown. The Warsh rate-hike narrative could fade quickly on a soft May inflation print, which would drag 30Y yields back below 5.0% and re-establish the Tuesday regime-resolution read. If SPX reclaims 7,440 with VIX settling below 17 by Thursday's close, the HOLD downgrade was correct but the re-upgrade to selective BUY is the move.
